external_relations.target_title: Interactive xtprompt refinement and clipboard acceptance

source.close_reason: Added and verified a one-line interactive startup hint pointing users to :help.
source.description:
## PROBLEM
Interactive mode starts by displaying the rewritten prompt and `xtprompt>` without telling users that commands exist. Users should discover at least the `:help` command without reading external documentation.

## SUCCESS
Every interactive session displays one concise startup hint before the first command prompt, naming `:help` and indicating that free text refines the current prompt.

## SCOPE
`packages/xtprompt/src/app.mjs`, focused package tests, and README only if behavior text needs synchronization.

## NON_GOALS
No full command list on every turn, no full-screen menu, and no command redesign.

## CONSTRAINTS
Keep the hint to one line, print it once per interactive session, preserve stdout isolation, and do not affect one-shot mode.

## VALIDATION
- [ ] A regression test asserts the startup hint contains `:help`.
- [ ] The hint appears exactly once even after refinements.
- [ ] Existing interactive and one-shot tests pass.

## OUTPUT
Report changed files and test evidence.
source.notes: Added one startup line: `xtprompt: Enter refinement text, or :help for commands.` It prints once before the first interactive input. Regression test asserts exactly one occurrence. Full tests and coverage pass; syntax checks pass; GitNexus impact LOW and final scope contains only runInteractive plus README.
